title: Profile Identity Resolution & Instant Loading (v0.4.10)
message: Resolves user identity display in Profile Fragment for both teachers and students, eliminating 'Loading Name...' with instant offline pre-caching.
changelog:
• Profile Name Resolution: Fixed missing name view binding in ProfileFragment to display student/teacher full name with fallback resolution across firstName, first_name, displayName, and email handle.
• Zero-Latency Identity Pre-warming: Pre-populates user name and avatar monogram directly from SharedPreferences and Firebase Auth.
• Placeholder Cleanup: Removed static 'Loading Name...' placeholder from layout XML.
